scanNote:
Grammar Book'ning 7-nazorat testi (83-bet). Workbook'ning 7-nazorat testi ham AYNAN shu unitlarni (13-14) qamraydi.

⚠ Ikkala kitob ham 'IT will be' ↔ 'THERE will be' qoidasini UCH martadan tekshiradi (bu yerda 4, 10, 14-bandlar). Demak bu — kitobning eng muhim deb hisoblagan qoidalaridan biri.

Bet burchagida QAYCHI belgisi (✂) bor — test qirqib olinadigan varaq.

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  B will        11  B because
   2  A 'm going    12  A leave
   3  C shouldn't   13  B Must
   4  A It          14  A There
   5  A can         15  B could
   6  C keep        16  A Can
   7  B shouldn't   17  A mustn't
   8  B buy         18  C to
   9  A mustn't     19  B am seeing
  10  C will be     20  B Why


MAVZULAR BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  KELAJAK ZAMON (Unit 13) —
     1, 2, 8, 10, 12, 19
  'IT/THERE will be' (Unit 13) — 4, 10, 14
  MODAL FE'LLAR (Unit 14) —
     3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 13, 15, 16, 17
  BOG'LOVChI VA MAQSAD — 11, 18
  TAKLIF ShAKLI — 20


⚠⚠ 'IT WILL BE' ↔ 'THERE WILL BE' —
UCh MARTA TEKShIRILGAN:

   4  'IT will be WINDY in Miami.'
      'windy' — SIFAT → IT

  10  'THERE will be SNOW in Toronto.'
      'snow' — OT → THERE

  14  'THERE will be RAIN tomorrow.'
      'rain' — OT → THERE

  ⚠ QOIDA:
     SIFAT bilan  → IT will be
        (sunny, rainy, windy, snowy, foggy)
     OT bilan     → THERE will be
        (sun, rain, wind, snow, fog)

  ⚠ Workbook'ning 7-nazorat testida ham
  AYNAN shu qoida uch marta tekshirilgan
  edi. Ikkala kitob ham buni ENG MUHIM
  deb hisoblaydi.


──── KELAJAK ZAMONNING UCh ShAKLI ────

  1) WILL — o'sha zahotgi qaror, bashorat

     1  'I'm hungry. I WILL make myself a
         sandwich.'
        ⚠ Hozir qaror qildi → WILL.
     8  'She WILL BUY a new car.'
    12  'I'LL LEAVE the keys on the table.'

     ⚠ 'will' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
        'will BUY'   ✓
        'will BUYS'  ✗
        'will BOUGHT' ✗

  2) BE GOING TO — niyat, reja

     2  'I'M GOING TO buy a new house next
         year.'
        ⚠ Oldindan o'ylangan NIYAT.
    18  'He'S GOING TO save money TO buy a
         bicycle.'

  3) PRESENT CONTINUOUS —
     rejalashtirilgan, kelishilgan

    19  'I AM SEEING Steve TONIGHT.'
        ⚠ Uchrashuv KELIShILGAN.
        'I see Steve tonight' — XATO;
        'I saw' — o'tmish.


⚠ 1 va 2-BANDLAR FARQI — MUHIM:

   1  'I'm hungry. I WILL make a sandwich.'
      → Hozir qorni ochdi, ShU ZAHOTI
        qaror qildi → WILL

   2  'I'M GOING TO buy a house next year.'
      → Oldindan o'ylangan REJA →
        BE GOING TO

  Bu — Unit 13 ning asosiy farqi!


──── MODAL FE'LLAR (Unit 14) ────

  MUST / MUSTN'T — majburiyat / TAQIQ

     6  'You MUST KEEP your room clean.'
        (majburiyat)
     9  'You MUSTN'T leave your dog alone
         all day.'
        (TAQIQ — hayvonga zarar)
    13  'MUST I go to bed so early?'
        (Majburmanmi?)
    17  'You MUSTN'T smoke in hospitals.'
        (TAQIQ — qonun)

  SHOULD / SHOULDN'T — MASLAHAT

     3  'Lynn SHOULDN'T eat so much
         chocolate.'
        (maslahat — sog'liq uchun)
     7  'You SHOULDN'T speak loudly in a
         library.'
        (odob qoidasi)

  CAN — qobiliyat, ruxsat, iltimos

     5  'She CAN speak Japanese.'
        (qobiliyat)
    16  'CAN we have some cake, please?'
        (iltimos)

  COULD — 'can' ning O'TMIShI

    15  'Steven COULD ride a bicycle when he
         WAS five.'
        ⚠ KALIT: 'when he WAS five' —
        o'tmish.


⚠ 'MUSTN'T' ↔ 'SHOULDN'T' FARQI:

  MUSTN'T — QAT'IY TAQIQ (qonun, xavf)
     'You MUSTN'T smoke in hospitals.'
     'You MUSTN'T leave your dog alone.'

  SHOULDN'T — MASLAHAT (yaxshi emas)
     'You SHOULDN'T eat so much chocolate.'
     'You SHOULDN'T speak loudly.'

  ⚠ Testda 3, 7 (shouldn't) va
  9, 17 (mustn't) — kitob ataylab
  yonma-yon qo'ygan.


⚠ MODAL FE'LLARDAN KEYIN ASOSIY ShAKL:

   6  'must KEEP'  ✓  'must KEEPS' ✗
   8  'will BUY'   ✓  'will BUYS'  ✗
  12  'I'll LEAVE' ✓  'I'll LEAVES' ✗

  ⚠ 3-shaxsda ham '-s' QO'ShILMAYDI.


──── BOG'LOVChI VA MAQSAD ────

  11  'He joined a gym BECAUSE he wanted to
      lose weight.'
      SABAB → BECAUSE.

  18  'He's going to save money TO buy a
      new bicycle.'
      ⚠ MAQSAD → 'TO + fe'l' ('... uchun').
      'because' bo'lsa 'because he wants
      to buy' bo'lardi.

  20  'WHY don't you stop eating sweets?'
      ⚠ 'Why don't you ...?' — MASLAHAT/
      TAKLIF shakli (turg'un qolip).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a sandwich  = sendvich
  to join a gym = sport zaliga yozilmoq
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq
  a library   = kutubxona
  alone       = yolg'iz
  windy       = shamolli
  to save money = pul yig'moq
  sweets      = shirinliklar
  keys        = kalitlar

items.textEn: 1  I'm hungry. I ................. make myself a sandwich.
items.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'I'm hungry' — HOZIR qorni ochdi,
SHU ZAHOTI qaror qildi → WILL.

⚠ 2-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
OLDINDAN o'ylangan reja → 'be going to'.

Bu — Unit 13 ning asosiy farqi!

items.textEn: 2  I ................. to buy a new house next year.
items.uz: Kelasi yil yangi uy sotib olmoqchiman.
items.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'TO buy' allaqachon bosilgan
→ 'be going TO'.

'next year' — oldindan o'ylangan NIYAT.

'will' bo'lsa 'will buy' bo'lardi ('to' siz).

items.textEn: 3  Lynn ................. eat so much chocolate.
items.uz: Linn bunchalik ko'p shokolad yemasligi kerak.
items.whyUz:
MASLAHAT (sog'liq uchun yomon) → SHOULDN'T.

⚠ 'must' — majburiyat, mantiqsiz.
⚠ 'should' — 'yeyishi kerak' degan ijobiy
ma'no berardi.

'so much chocolate' — sanalmaydigan.

items.textEn: 4  ................. will be windy in Miami on Tuesday.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'WINDY' — SIFAT → 'IT will be'.

⚠ 10 va 14-bandlar bilan solishtiring:
u yerda OT ('snow', 'rain') → 'THERE will be'.

'It's will be' — ikki fe'l, XATO.

items.textEn: 5  Lucy lives in Tokyo. She ................. speak Japanese.
items.uz: Lyusi Tokioda yashaydi. U yaponcha gapira oladi.
items.whyUz:
QOBILIYAT → CAN.

KALIT: Tokioda yashaydi → tilni biladi.

'mustn't' — taqiq, mantiqsiz;
'will' — kelajak, mantiqsiz.

items.textEn: 6  You must ................. your room clean.
items.whyUz:
⚠ MODAL FE'LDAN keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'must KEEP'    ✓
  'must KEEPS'   ✗
  'must KEEPING' ✗

'keep something clean' = toza tutmoq
(Coursebook 101-bet).

items.textEn: 7  You ................. speak loudly in a library.
items.whyUz:
ODOB QOIDASI → SHOULDN'T (maslahat).

⚠ 9 va 17-bandlar bilan solishtiring: u yerda
QAT'IY TAQIQ → 'mustn't'.

Kutubxonada baland gapirish — qonunbuzarlik
emas, odobsizlik.

items.textEn: 8  She will ................. a new car.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'WILL' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'will BUY'     ✓
  'will BUYS'    ✗
  'will BOUGHT'  ✗

3-shaxsda ham '-s' QO'SHILMAYDI.

items.textEn: 9  You ................. leave your dog alone in the house all day.
items.uz: Itingizni butun kun uyda yolg'iz qoldirmang.
items.whyUz:
QAT'IY TAQIQ (hayvonga zarar) → MUSTN'T.

⚠ 3 va 7-bandlar bilan solishtiring:
u yerda MASLAHAT → 'shouldn't'.

'couldn't' — o'tmish;
'had' — modal fe'l emas.

items.textEn: 10  There ................. snow in Toronto tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
⚠ IKKI KALIT:
a) 'THERE' bosilgan → keyin OT ('snow');
b) 'TOMORROW' → KELAJAK → 'will be'.

'are' / 'is' — hozirgi zamon, 'tomorrow' ga
zid.

4-band bilan solishtiring: 'IT will be WINDY'.

items.textEn: 11  He joined a gym ................. he wanted to lose weight.
items.uz: U sport zaliga yozildi, chunki vazn tashlamoqchi edi.
items.whyUz:
SABAB → BECAUSE.

[natija] BECAUSE [sabab]:
vazn tashlash istagi — SABAB,
zalga yozilish — NATIJA.

⚠ 'so' bo'lsa tartib teskari bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 12  I'll ................. the keys on the table.
items.whyUz:
'I'LL' = I WILL → keyin ASOSIY shakl.

  'I'll LEAVE'    ✓
  'I'll LEAVES'   ✗
  'I'll LEAVING'  ✗

'leave' bu yerda = QOLDIRMOQ (ketmoq emas).

items.textEn: 13  ................. I go to bed so early?
items.whyUz:
'MUST I ...?' = Majburmanmi?

KALIT: 'so early' — norozilik ohangi, ya'ni
MAJBURIYAT haqida so'rayapti.

⚠ 'Can I ...?' — ruxsat so'rash (16-band).
⚠ 'Mustn't I ...?' — g'alati savol.

items.textEn: 14  ................. will be rain tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'RAIN' — OT → 'THERE will be'.

⚠ 4-band bilan solishtiring:
  'IT will be RAINY' (sifat)
  'THERE will be RAIN' (ot)

10-band bilan bir xil qoida ('snow' — ot).

items.textEn: 15  Steven ................. ride a bicycle when he was five years old.
items.uz: Stiven besh yoshida velosiped mina olardi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'when he WAS five' — O'TMISH.

'could' — 'can' ning o'tmish shakli
(qobiliyat).

'must' / 'should' — hozirgi zamon modal
fe'llari, o'tmishga mos kelmaydi.

items.textEn: 16  ................. we have some cake, please?
items.whyUz:
ILTIMOS → CAN.

KALIT: 'PLEASE' iltimosni ko'rsatadi.

⚠ ILTIMOSDA savol bo'lsa ham 'SOME'
('any' emas).
⚠ 'Must we ...?' = majburmizmi? (13-band).

items.textEn: 17  You ................. smoke in hospitals.
items.whyUz:
QAT'IY TAQIQ (qonun) → MUSTN'T.

⚠ Coursebook 114-bet, 6-mashqning 6-bandi
AYNAN shu xato edi: 'You MUST smoke in
hospitals' → 'MUSTN'T'.

⚠ Workbook 7-nazorat testida ham bor edi.

items.textEn: 18  He's going to save money ................. buy a new bicycle.
items.uz: U yangi velosiped sotib olish uchun pul yig'moqchi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ MAQSAD → 'TO + fe'l' ('... uchun').

'save money TO BUY a bicycle' = velosiped
sotib olish UCHUN pul yig'moq.

⚠ 'because' bo'lsa 'because he WANTS TO buy'
bo'lardi (ega va fe'l kerak).

⚠ KELISHILGAN uchrashuv → PRESENT
CONTINUOUS (kelajak ma'nosida).

'TONIGHT' — rejalashtirilgan vaqt.

'saw' — o'tmish;
'see' — doimiy odat ('I see him every day').

items.textEn: 20  ................. don't you stop eating sweets?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'WHY don't you ...?' — MASLAHAT/TAKLIF
shakli (TURG'UN QOLIP).

'How don't you' / 'When don't you' — mavjud
emas.

'stop + V-ing' = ... ni to'xtatmoq.

patterns.formula: IT WILL BE + [SIFAT].   /   THERE WILL BE + [OT].
patterns.exampleEn: It will be windy in Miami. There will be snow in Toronto. There will be rain tomorrow.
patterns.exampleUz: Mayamida shamolli bo'ladi. Torontoda qor bo'ladi. Ertaga yomg'ir bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Testning ENG MUHIM qoidasi — 3 marta
tekshirilgan.

patterns.formula: [hozirgi holat]. I WILL + [ASOSIY fe'l].   ↔   I AM GOING TO + [ASOSIY fe'l] + [kelajak vaqt].
patterns.exampleEn: I'm hungry. I will make a sandwich.  /  I'm going to buy a house next year.
patterns.exampleUz: Qornim och. Sendvich tayyorlayman. / Kelasi yil uy sotib olmoqchiman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ WILL — shu zahotgi qaror;
BE GOING TO — oldindan o'ylangan niyat.

patterns.exampleEn: You mustn't smoke in hospitals. You shouldn't speak loudly in a library.
He's going to save money to buy a new bicycle.
patterns.exampleUz: U yangi velosiped sotib olish uchun pul yig'moqchi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'TO + fe'l' — MAQSAD ('... uchun').
'because' bo'lsa ega va fe'l kerak bo'lardi.

patterns.exampleEn: Why don't you stop eating sweets?
